name: NANO Nuclear Energy Inc.
blurb: NANO Nuclear Energy Inc. is a pre-revenue nuclear energy development company focused on advanced microreactor and small modular reactor (SMR) technologies. Its portfolio includes four reactor concepts: KRONOS (high-temperature gas-cooled reactor), LOKI (compact microreactor for remote applications), ZEUS (solid core battery reactor), and ODIN (low-pressure salt coolant reactor). Beyond reactors, the company is developing a high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) fuel processing facility as well as fuel transportation and nuclear consulting businesses. With only 36 employees and no revenue as of its latest filings, NNE is firmly in early-stage development, targeting the emerging market for distributed and off-grid nuclear power.
